name: Brutal
description: Neo-brutalist: square slabs with 3px ink borders and hard offset shadows, oversized uppercase Archivo Black over Atkinson Hyperlegible, Space Mono tape labels, one safety-orange flood on off-white.

name: Editorial
description: Magazine layout: high-contrast Fraunces display over a Source Serif text face, ink on warm paper, one vermilion accent, asymmetric columns separated by hairline rules instead of cards.

name: Soft Utility
description: Calm product UI for tools and SaaS: a humanist Red Hat Display over Source Sans 3, dense 15px type, sage-tinted neutrals, one muted teal accent, and layered rounded panels built from hairline borders plus a single soft shadow tier.

name: Swiss
description: International Typographic Style: a strict 12-column grid, a heavy neo-grotesk set flush-left, steep size jumps, black on off-white and one signal red.
